reserveReview.rationale: The pinned issuer configuration classifies CADm as reserve-backed, and the pinned deployment registry contains no CADm borrower branch. The issuer-run reserve API was re-read on 2026-07-27 and reported $18,784,067.026359823 of total collateral, including a native ETH row on Ethereum (0.8806377328%) and a residual Celo WETH row (0.0006888386%) that the Pharos Mento adapter reports as one combined 'ETH' slice. The authored fallback groups only API rows that represent the same stablecoin family and retains every positive category, including the combined 0.8813265714% ETH slice. This independently re-verifies the high-risk CELO slice; the unsafe-backing cap correctly remains.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Shared Mento Reserve composition measured by the issuer-run live API; reserve-backed classification and absence of a CADm borrower branch verified in pinned issuer repositories
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No separate CADm borrower collateral exists. Every positive shared-reserve API row is retained in the eight normalized stablecoin-family or exogenous-asset slices, and the observed 16.9720038629% CELO share remains explicitly high risk.
